data.title: Choose the sentence that uses the word correctly.

words.word: Although it was raining, we went out.
Although of the rain, we went out.
Although means because.
Even though he was tired, he continued.
Even though of being tired, he continued.
Even though means so that.
We will leave unless it rains.
We will leave unless it will rain.
Unless means because.
She likes coffee, whereas he prefers tea.
Whereas of liking coffee, he prefers tea.
Whereas is a verb.
She was reading while he was cooking.
She was reading during he cooked.
While means therefore.
He stayed home because he was ill.
He stayed home because of he was ill.
Because means although.
Since it was late, we left.
Since of being late, we left.
Since means unless.
Wash your hands before dinner.
Wash your hands before to dinner.
Before means after.
We met after the meeting.
We met after of the meeting.
After means before.
She whispered so that no one could hear.
She whispered so that to not hear.
So that means although.
